message.content: On the discussion from April 10, 2026 (20260410), the Jolly band decides to work on the song "Stand By Me" for their jam session. Wolfgang Schulz suggests this because he mentions that it has a "nice groove" and that the entire group can participate, indicating that they believe it would be suitable and enjoyable for the jam session. Li Hua agrees enthusiastically, stating that they should "mix things up a bit" and that this classic song would be a great choice to add variety to their repertoire. Yuriko Yamamoto supports the idea, agreeing that it would be "nice to play together" and looks forward to working on it. Thus, the song "Stand By Me" is selected for the upcoming jam session.
